title: Neon Snake Arcade
description: Navigate the neon snake across a high-speed grid, consume quantum particles, and climb the global leaderboards without striking the containment field.
controls: Arrow Keys or WASD to navigate. On mobile use the virtual D-pad.

title: Cyber Pong
description: High-velocity table tennis match featuring dynamic curve physics, reactive paddle collisions, single-player vs neural AI, and 2-player local battle mode.
controls: Player 1: W/S or Mouse/Touch · Player 2: Up/Down Arrows

title: Quantum Breakout
description: Shatter prismatic energy bricks in this neon paddle breaker with multi-row combo scoring, deflecting angles, and responsive touch/mouse tracking.
controls: Mouse, Touch, or Left/Right Arrow to maneuver the paddle.

title: 2048 Classic
description: Slide matching numeric tiles across the 4x4 matrix, fuse powers of two, and reach the legendary 2048 milestone. Includes instant undo and best score saves.
controls: Arrow Keys, WASD, or swipe anywhere on touchscreens to slide.

title: Pixel Flap
description: Carefully time your wing flaps through perilous pipe gauntlets in this unforgiving high-gravity pixel trial. Every pipe cleared tests pure reflex.
controls: Spacebar, Left Click, or Tap Screen to flap wings.

title: Space Defender
description: Pilot the orbital photon turret against descending alien battle fleets. Dodge enemy laser barrages and clear alien waves before ground invasion.
controls: A/D or Left/Right Arrow to steer · Spacebar or Fire button to shoot.

title: Block Drop Classic
description: Standard 7-piece tetromino dropping simulator featuring ghost piece projections, piece rotation kicks, line clear streaks, and speed progression.
controls: Left/Right to move, Up to rotate, Down to soft drop, Space to hard drop.

title: Retro Minesweeper
description: Uncover grid sectors using deductive logic, flag suspected explosive mines, and beat the clock in 9x9 Easy and 12x12 Medium tactical board sizes.
controls: Left click to reveal · Right click or long press on touch to flag.

title: Cyber Dash
description: High-octane endless side-scrolling dash across neon cyber rooftops. Leap over barrier pylons, slide beneath deadly laser beams, and collect power coins.
controls: Spacebar or Up Arrow to jump · Down Arrow to slide.

title: Cyber Wordle
description: Six attempts to decipher the secret 5-letter access key. Colored feedback indicates letters in the exact slot, letters misplaced, or invalid characters.
controls: Type on physical keyboard or click/tap virtual keypad.

title: Vector Asteroids
description: Authentic vector-line space physics arcade simulator. Rotate your starcraft with inertia dampeners, pulse thrusters, and vaporize fractured space rock clusters.
controls: Left/Right Arrow to turn · Up Arrow for thrust · Spacebar to fire lasers.
